name: kitchensink4word
description: Lets Claude write and edit Word documents for you: text, tables, footnotes, citations, tracked changes, comments, and live edits to the document you have open in Word.
long_description: KitchenSink4Word connects Claude to your Word documents. Ask it to draft sections, fix citations, apply tracked changes, build tables, or edit the document you have open in Word while you watch. Every change lands after an automatic backup, the work is checked when it saves, and nothing about your documents leaves your machine. Part of the KitchenSink4 family (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Web) from KitchenSink4AI (kitchensink4.ai).

all_tools.title: Load every tool at startup
all_tools.description: Off: starts with the core set, and Claude can ask for more mid-session. On: every tool loads from the first message, which costs more of Claude's working memory but never needs a follow-up. Use with care: the full set includes the tools that drive the real application.

lock_tools.title: Lock the tool set at startup
lock_tools.description: On: the tools chosen at startup are final, and nothing can add more mid-session. A safety preference; most people leave it off.
